'''2018 European MPC Results Gosse Zeilstra DS Twin Suns Of Tatooine''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Gosse Zeilstra]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Gosse Zeilstra]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Twin Suns Of Tatooine / Well Trained In The Jedi Arts|VP-D-twinsunsoftatooine.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Twin Suns Of Tatooine Zeilstra 3.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
